candidates.topic: Waxing Crescent Moon in Sagittarius — Fire Under Scorpio Intensity
candidates.teaser: The Moon just moved into Sagittarius — and it's pulling hard against everything Scorpio season is demanding of you.
candidates.video_title: Waxing Crescent in Sagittarius — The Escape Urge Is Real
candidates.video_description: With the Sun deep in Scorpio and the Moon waxing in Sagittarius, there's a tension between going deeper and running free. Here's how astrology reads that push-pull.
candidates.script: Your instincts are pulling in two opposite directions right now — and the sky explains why. The Sun is at 19° Scorpio, pressing you inward, into depth, shadow, and truth. But the Moon is waxing in Sagittarius, craving freedom, expansion, and escape. In astrology, this tension is intentional — Sagittarius needs the fire to run, Scorpio needs you to stay and face it. The question is which one wins today. Which sign are you?

candidates.topic: Five Planets Retrograde — What Saturn and Neptune Conjunct in Aries Means
candidates.teaser: Five planets are still retrograde — and two of them are sitting on top of each other in a sign they haven't touched in over 150 years.
candidates.video_title: 5 Planets Retrograde — The Two That Change Everything
candidates.video_description: Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are all retrograde right now. But Saturn at 8° and Neptune at 1° Aries retrograde together is the alignment astrologers have been watching for decades.
candidates.script: Five planets are retrograde right now — but most people are watching the wrong one. Saturn is at 8° Aries retrograde, Neptune is at 1° Aries retrograde, and they are pulling toward each other in a sign neither planet has occupied in over 150 years. In astrology, Saturn dissolves Neptune's illusions — or Neptune erodes Saturn's structures. Everything you thought was solid is being quietly questioned. The rebuild doesn't start until they both move forward. Are you ready for that?

candidates.topic: Venus Retrograde in Libra — What Late Degree Retrogrades Actually Do
candidates.teaser: Venus is retrograde in Libra right now — and most people have no idea what a retrograde in the sign a planet rules actually means.
candidates.video_title: Venus Retrograde in Its Own Sign — This Is Rare
candidates.video_description: Venus retrograde at 23° Libra is unusual because Libra is Venus's home sign. Astrologers interpret this as a deeply internal review of worth, beauty, and what you've settled for in relationships.
candidates.script: Venus retrograde hits differently when it's in the sign it rules — and right now Venus is at 23° Libra, retrograde, in its own home. In astrology, this means the planet of love and worth is turning its full power inward. It's not just reviewing relationships — it's reviewing every compromise you've made, every time you chose peace over truth, every standard you quietly lowered. This retrograde ends soon. What are you going back to fix? Which sign are you?

candidates.topic: Uranus in Gemini Retrograde — The Information Age Gets Rewired
candidates.teaser: Uranus just entered Gemini for the first time in 84 years — and it's already retrograde, which changes everything about what this shift means.
candidates.video_title: Uranus in Gemini Retrograde — 84 Years Since This Happened
candidates.video_description: Uranus entered Gemini for the first time since the 1940s and is already retrograde at 4°. Astrologers associate this placement with radical disruption of communication, technology, and how humanity processes information.
candidates.script: The last time Uranus was in Gemini, the world was rewriting how it communicated — and now it's back. Uranus entered Gemini for the first time in 84 years, and right now it's retrograde at 4°, which means that revolution is turning inward first. In astrology, Uranus in Gemini rewires minds, media, language, and technology at a collective level. The retrograde phase means the disruption is building beneath the surface before it breaks open. You'll feel it before you see it.
